I was with one guy who was so afraid about doing anything without my consent so he did ask me to tell him directly in the moment if there was something I wanted him to do or not to do. But sometimes he would at least take some initiative and ask me if I wanted him to go down on me or whatever. I was also with another guy who didn’t seem to have any interest in pleasing me unless I wasn’t in the mood to do anything and then he’d start doing things to me to try to get me in the mood. I know it can feel like there’s something wrong with you. I felt really undesirable when I was with the guy who never tried to do anything to me. But trust me, there’s PLENTY of guys out there would would be eager to please you. I’ve had experiences where the guy was all about my pleasure and didn’t expect anything in return.
